svg.title: A quotient and its derivative
svg.desc: Top: the graph of f(x) = x over (x squared plus 1), which rises from near 0 on the left to a high point at (1, 0.5) after a low point at (minus 1, minus 0.5). Tangent lines are drawn at x = minus 1 and 1, both flat, and at x = 0, with slope 1. Bottom: the graph of f prime of x = (1 minus x squared) over (x squared plus 1) squared, from the quotient rule. It crosses 0 at x = minus 1 and 1 and has height 1 at x = 0.
